description: Version, MOTD, players, uptime, difficulty, view distance, worlds, data packs, and load: TPS over 1, 5, and 15 minutes (20 is perfect), ms per tick, memory, chunks, entities. `platform` (paper, fabric, neoforge), `side` (integrated is singleplayer), `lan`, `cheats`, and `paused`. include adds `performance` (tick percentiles, CPU, entities per world, JVM memory, GC, threads), `host` (OS, CPUs, RAM, disk, container limits, needs system:read), and `restart` (a pending restart or stop).
